title: Spiderling's '+1 Might for each other unit you control here with my name' is applied as a flat +1 regardless of how many other Spiderlings share its location
expected: Parser emits {type:"modify-might", amount:1, per:"other unit you control here with my name", target:"self"} at packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/parsers/static-parser.ts:616-634 for "I have +N [Might] for each QUALIFIER". The engine's applyStaticEffect (packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/static-abilities.ts:515-585) only handles numeric amount, {cardsInTrash}, {count}, and {score}; a numeric amount is used verbatim (line 518-519) and `effect.per` is never read anywhere in riftbound-engine/src (grep for `.per`/"per" returns nothing). So Spiderling always gets staticMightBonus = +1 regardless of how many same-named units share its location (should be 0 alone, N-1 with N together).
observed: meta.staticMightBonus was 1 in every configuration: a single Spiderling alone in base (others still in hand) had staticMightBonus=1; one at battlefield + one at base (different locations) each had 1; all three together at battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-276-298 each still had staticMightBonus=1. Parsed ability is {type:static, effect:{type:modify-might, amount:1, target:self, per:"other unit you control here with my name"}} — the `per` string is not evaluated, so amount is applied once unconditionally.
